verdict.rationale: Capacities' own docs explicitly describe the mobile app as 'a companion to desktop for day-to-day work in your space: search and capture on the go' (capacities-docs-12), which is the opposite of the 'full-featured, not stripped-down companion' story — no mention of full linking, graph view, or complete editing capabilities on mobile. No evidence contradicts or overrides this vendor description with a fuller feature set for iOS/Android.
